title: RTX Corporation Q2 2026 Form 10-Q
excerpt: At June 30, 2026, RTX reported USD 8.305 billion of cash, USD 37.383 billion of total debt, and 1,347,758,144 common shares outstanding.
summary: The unchanged SEC-filed quarterly report verifies RTX's current share count, net-debt inputs, segment economics, cash flow, contract risks, and Pratt powder-metal remediation exposure for the scenario-complete review.
